movers.text: QB Lamar Jackson (right thumb) to have surgery and go on IR, per coach Jesse Minter; could be season-ending. Tyler Huntley (turf toe) questionable; rookie Joe Fagnano (knee) finished Sunday.
Coach Shane Steichen said he'll evaluate whether Daniel Jones remains the starting QB after 42-7 loss at JAX. Anthony Richardson played the final three drives.
QB Jacoby Brissett (10/23, 118 yds, INT) pulled late in 3rd qtr at Dallas; Gardner Minshew led four straight TD drives in OT win. No starter named yet for Week 9.
LB Jack Campbell (neck) placed on a backboard and carted off vs. Minnesota; kept overnight in hospital for evaluation. Listed doubtful.
LT Charles Cross (ankle) ruled out for Monday vs. Chicago after missing practice all week. G Anthony Bradford (knee) questionable.

BAL.text: QB Lamar Jackson (right thumb) to have surgery and go on IR, per coach Jesse Minter; could be season-ending. Tyler Huntley (turf toe) questionable; rookie Joe Fagnano (knee) finished Sunday.
OL: G Olaivavega Ioane (knee, MCL) and OT Emery Jones Jr. both inactive in Week 8 loss to Buffalo. S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) also out.

IND.text: Coach Shane Steichen said he'll evaluate whether Daniel Jones remains the starting QB after 42-7 loss at JAX. Anthony Richardson played the final three drives.

ARI.text: QB Jacoby Brissett (10/23, 118 yds, INT) pulled late in 3rd qtr at Dallas; Gardner Minshew led four straight TD drives in OT win. No starter named yet for Week 9.
WR Michael Wilson questionable after saying he suffered two broken ribs in Sunday's win at Dallas. G Jon Gaines II (ankle) inactive again.

DET.text: LB Jack Campbell (neck) placed on a backboard and carted off vs. Minnesota; kept overnight in hospital for evaluation. Listed doubtful.

SEA.text: LT Charles Cross (ankle) ruled out for Monday vs. Chicago after missing practice all week. G Anthony Bradford (knee) questionable.

MIN.text: QB Kyler Murray listed questionable (hamstring) after playing all of Sunday's 19-15 loss at Detroit; status to be monitored this week.

LA.text: Secondary: CB Jaylen Watson (shoulder) ruled out and CB Trent McDuffie (back) questionable to return vs. Chargers; Josh Wallace, Emmanuel Forbes took on more snaps.
Edge Myles Garrett (knee, IR) expected to return to practice in Week 9, per Ian Rapoport; hasn't played since aggravating the knee in the opener.

GB.text: OL: OT Travis Glover (knee) and G Sean Rhyan (ankle) both inactive Thursday vs. Carolina. LB Zaire Franklin (shin) also out.
Edge Micah Parsons reportedly closing in on a November return.

CAR.text: OL: G Damien Lewis (knee) out and OT Taylor Moton (lower leg) on IR. Defense: CB Akayleb Evans (IR), CB Will Lee (hamstring) hurt, edge Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) out.

PHI.text: WRs DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) inactive for a 2nd straight week. LB Jihaad Campbell (hamstring) and C Jake Majors also out.

WAS.text: DL: DTs Daron Payne (foot) and Javon Kinlaw (knee) both inactive vs. Eagles. WR Terry McLaurin (torn patellar tendon) had surgery, on IR.

KC.text: CB: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) downgraded to out vs. Denver; L'Jarius Sneed (knee) placed on IR Saturday.

DEN.text: Safeties: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) inactive and Brandon Jones (hamstring) left Sunday's win vs. KC; CB Kris Abrams-Draine (ankle) also exited.

CIN.text: CB DJ Turner II (ankle) ruled out in 4th qtr of OT win vs. Tennessee; DJ Ivey stepped in. S Kyle Dugger (quad) inactive.

TEN.text: OL: G Peter Skoronski (hamstring) and OT JC Latham (finger) both left Sunday's OT loss at Cincinnati, questionable to return. WR Carnell Tate (shoulder) inactive.

TB.text: WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) inactive for a 2nd straight game vs. Atlanta.

JAX.text: RT Anton Harrison (torn ACL) on IR. G Ezra Cleveland (ankle) questionable; DE Travon Walker (ribs) left Sunday's win vs. Indianapolis.
